stage0089a_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Was it you who summoned me,
　Olympus's King of the Underworld?」

stage0089a_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Embodiment of darkness.
　Was it not you who summoned me?」

stage0089a_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Seems you too received a summons.」

stage0089a_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... I have a rough idea
　who's behind this.」

stage0089a_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Very well.
　This gathering, too, must be some kind of fate...
　Let us talk a while.」

stage0089a_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Claim over that blue star
　belongs to the gods of Olympus.
　I have nothing more to say.」

stage0089a_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Rather admirable, for one
　who bears the name Demon King.」

stage0089a_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Or do you mean, shamelessly,
　to profit off a fight between
　the gods of Olympus and mankind?」

stage0089a_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Watch your mouth.
　Do you want to start
　the real war here?」

stage0089a_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「My apologies...
　But the one I must defeat
　lies elsewhere.」

stage0089a_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「Them, hm...
　That wish is ours as well.」

stage0089a_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Then what of the dimensional cage?」

stage0089a_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「I know not what purpose lay
　behind hiding that star, but to us,
　such a thing means nothing.」

stage0089a_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... though the humans
　are running around in circles.」

stage0089a_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「But do not underestimate them.
　They've already entered the Age of the Sun.」

stage0089a_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「The one who holds that key is him...」

stage0089a_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The man known as the Red Comet...」

stage0089a_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Fufufu... it should be a sight,
　seeing how far humans can go.」

stage0089a_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ハーデス$$
「By the time we next meet,
　things will likely have moved.」

stage0089a_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Until then, let us part for a while...」

stage0089a_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「For us who live forever,
　that is but a moment's time, though...」

stage0089a_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$カヲル$$
「...Did you want to show me them?」

stage0089a_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カヲル$$
「Those who forgot their duty as higher beings...
　But I can't bring myself to hate them
　for living by their desires.」

stage0089a_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$カヲル$$
「We do not needlessly interfere
　with our immature brothers...
　Such a rule is merely presumptuous.」

stage0089a_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$カヲル$$
「In truth, you committed a grave sin
　24,000 years ago.」

stage0089a_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$カヲル$$
「And further, 12,000 years ago,
　I acknowledge one who overturned
　the cycle of rebirth... of fate.」

stage0089a_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$カヲル$$
「And you told a painful lie
　to divert their eyes and protect
　your former lover.」

stage0089a_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$カヲル$$
「That's right...
　That's why we need a future.」

stage0089a_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$カヲル$$
「No gods, no humans...
　A future where everyone lives freely
　and earnestly for the world they want...」

stage0089a_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text: ～ $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ Command Room ～

stage0089a_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...Freak weather breaking out worldwide?」

stage0089a_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Abnormal heat and cold, torrential rain and snow,
　giant typhoons, tornadoes...
　None of it can be explained.」

stage0089a_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Is it because the $$エタニティ・フラット$$ is nearing completion?」

stage0089a_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「No...
　Even Dr. $$トライア$$ says this situation
　was completely unexpected.」

stage0089a_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「According to $$ＷＩＬＬ$$'s analysis, it seems the cause is
　an imbalance between this planet's dimensions.」

stage0089a_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$オットー$$
「An imbalance between dimensions...?
　Doesn't that contradict the boundary being fixed?」

stage0089a_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「True, if this situation continues,
　even the Prison of Time might be destroyed...」

stage0089a_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「That would mean the Earth gets crushed between dimensions.」

stage0089a_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Why on earth did it come to this...」

stage0089a_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$クレア$$
「All of this is the effect of the Mythical Aquarion.」

stage0089a_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$クレア$$
「With the Mythical Aquarion's seal broken,
　the balance between Altair and Vega,
　maintained until now, has collapsed...」

stage0089a_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$クレア$$
「No... I'd say it's the balance of this world itself,
　born of the $$新世時空震動$$, that has collapsed.」

stage0089a_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So Aquarion was a pillar supporting the world...」

stage0089a_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$クレア$$
「Yes, I believe it's in a similar state.」

stage0089a_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Then if we demand the Mythical Aquarion's return,
　wouldn't Altair comply?」

stage0089a_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$クレア$$
「If it's Supreme Commander $$イズモ・カムロギ$$...」

stage0089a_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The problem is that $$ミカゲ$$, huh...」

stage0089a_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$クレア$$
「It seems Captain $$ブライト$$ knows of him...
　no, of the $$堕天翅$$ and $$頭翅$$ that created him.」

stage0089a_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The very existence of the $$堕天翅$$
　was beyond our understanding...」

stage0089a_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Among them, $$頭翅$$ would sacrifice the whole world
　without hesitation, for their own love and hatred.
　If that hatred has hardened even further...」

stage0089a_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$クレア$$
「Altair and Vega...
　Even if both worlds were to collapse, they wouldn't care...
　In fact, they might even be hoping for exactly that.」

stage0089a_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「According to $$アドヴェント$$,
　it seems he too will move
　once the $$エタニティ・フラット$$ is ready.」

stage0089a_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The singularity search and Neo Zeon
　matter too, but first we must face
　the crisis in front of us, huh...」

stage0089a_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Even from what we've seen so far,
　$$ミカゲ$$ is moving on a separate
　track from Altair's main army.」

stage0089a_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「To him, Altair is probably nothing more than a tool to use.」

stage0089a_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$クレア$$
「Fortunately, the Mythical Aquarion cannot be
　activated unless three chosen Elements
　are aboard it.」

stage0089a_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「At least it seems we can avoid that power being used directly.」

stage0089a_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Still, we must head to Altair as soon as possible
　and take back the Aquarion.」

stage0089a_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「The problem is how we get to Altair, huh...」

stage0089a_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$クレア$$
「According to $$不動$$, the Aquarion power
　$$アンディ$$ awakened, the Dimension Tunnel Shell,
　can locally distort the dimensional boundary.」

stage0089a_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Where is Supreme Commander $$不動$$ now?」

stage0089a_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$クレア$$
「After the last battle, he set out
　on another journey without telling
　anyone where he was going.」

stage0089a_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$オットー$$
「Even though the world might end...!?」

stage0089a_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Analysis complete. Fold navigation
　combined with space warped by the
　Dimension Tunnel Shell allows a limited leap.」

stage0089a_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「And given this world's connection
　to it, folding to the Altair realm
　should also be possible.」

stage0089a_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$ＷＩＬＬ$$... what's the chance we
　can reach the Altair realm?」

stage0089a_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's too low a success rate to bet everything on.」

stage0089a_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If we're unlucky, we might just end up
　wandering that dimension forever...」

stage0089a_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「If only we had something to show
　the way to the Altair realm, the
　success rate would jump up...」

stage0089a_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$シュレード$$
「I've heard most of what was said.」

stage0089a_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Would you let me handle this?」

stage0089a_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「You have a way to reach Altair?」

stage0089a_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$シュレード$$
「If I combine my strength with $$バサラ$$'s...
　and $$アルト$$'s.」

stage0089a_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$クレア$$
「You can't!
　Your body is already...!」

stage0089a_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$シュレード$$
「I know my own body better than anyone.」

stage0089a_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$シュレード$$
「But with the world in crisis,
　I can't afford to worry about that now.」

stage0089a_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$シュレード$$
「It's alright, Chairwoman $$クレア$$.
　It's not that I want to die either.」

stage0089a_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$シュレード$$
「I'm not $n,
　but I'll try to resist fate too.」

stage0089a_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Right... to complete the ultimate melody too.」

stage0089a_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ランカ$$
（$$バサラ$$ and $$シュレード$$'s songs
　melted into one with ours...）

stage0089a_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$シェリル$$
（Now all we can do is wait for everyone
　to come...）

stage0089a_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Singing's over already?
　Until just now you kept singing
　no matter how much I told you to stop.」

stage0089a_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Shut up for a bit, you beast.」

stage0089a_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Being stalked by a beast like you,
　poor $$ミコノ$$ must be so annoyed.」

stage0089a_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Say whatever you want.
　$$シルフィ$$ and I have been fated to be together
　since twelve thousand years ago.」

stage0089a_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Fate, huh...
　Maybe you should learn that there are people
　who won't lose to something like that.」

stage0089a_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You... don't think that just because you're
　the strongest $$レア・イグラー$$, you can't be killed.」

stage0089a_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Neither $$ミカゲ$$ nor I care anymore
　about $$レア・イグラー$$s.」

stage0089a_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$シェリル$$
「You're saying you don't care what happens
　to the planet you grew up on?」

stage0089a_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$カグラ$$
「It's got nothing to do with me!
　As long as I have that damn woman... $$シルフィ$$... that's all I need!」

stage0089a_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$シェリル$$
「What a ridiculous 《$$リン・ミンメイ$$》...」

stage0089a_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$シェリル$$
「A legendary songstress.
　She too said that as long as she had
　the man she loved, nothing else mattered.」

stage0089a_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Though that's probably just fiction added after the fact.」

stage0089a_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I don't really get it, but I guess that's the same as me.」

stage0089a_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$シェリル$$
「I'll tell you something else while I'm at it.
　Afterward, she got slapped by the man she loved.」

stage0089a_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Are you saying $$シルフィ$$ will hit me?」

stage0089a_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$シェリル$$
「It won't be $$ミコノ$$ who hits you, it'll be $$アマタ$$.
　You'd better be ready.」

stage0089a_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Tch... you never shut up, do you.」

stage0089a_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$カグラ$$
「The scent of that coward $$アマタ$$ is drawing near.
　Better go greet them.」

stage0089a_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Too bad.
　Anyone who takes the side of that coward $$アマタ$$,
　I'll kill the whole lot of you.」

stage0089a_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Truly a blood-thirsty beast...
　Like Apollo, only even more savage.」

stage0089a_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$シェリル$$
「It's alright, $$ランカ$$-chan.
　$$アルト$$ and $c will definitely come to save us.」

stage0089a_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ランカ$$
「I... I understand how that $$カグラ$$ person feels...」

stage0089a_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ランカ$$
「That feeling of being willing to sacrifice anything
　for someone precious to you...」

stage0089a_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A girl with pale green hair truly is
　an admirable thing, isn't she.」

stage0089a_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Don't make such a scary face.
　You two still have work left to do, after all.」

stage0089a_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Too bad for you.
　I do feel for this planet,
　but I have no intention of becoming the true Eve.」

stage0089a_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... so you too have someone
　you care deeply for, in your heart.」

stage0089a_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... that's how it should be.
　That's why I brought you two here.」

stage0089a_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$シェリル$$
「You... what are you planning to do?」
